cabins.label: Guest cabins
cabins.assumption: Between Walden's 15 tents and the Presidio's 14 rooms [^30,32], small enough to fill midweek with one retreat group and weekends with couples.

site_acres.label: Site area, acres
site_acres.assumption: Ten acres hold 14 cabins, a lodge, parking and the septic field on well and septic service, with room to keep cabins apart.

tract_ask.label: Asking price of the 40-acre US 290 tract used as the land benchmark

cabin_cost.label: Cost per cabin, built and set
cabin_cost.assumption: No per-cabin cost is published for the Hill Country. Census put the 2025 South average for new single-family homes at $155.62 per sq ft before land [^43], and NAHB put the 2024 West South Central custom-home median at $138 [^44]. A small cabin carries a full bath, kitchenette, deck and hot tub in a fraction of a house's floor area, so we carry $120,000 per unit.

lodge_cost.label: Lodge with meeting hall, prep kitchen and restrooms
lodge_cost.assumption: Sized to seat about 100 for a banquet, the capacity Walden markets [^31]. No published benchmark.

site_work.label: Well, septic, electric extension, roads and parking
site_work.assumption: Water and sewer service for the tract were NOT FOUND; the land listing cites groundwater in the vicinity [^9]. Allowance pending a civil engineer's estimate.

soft_pct.label: Soft costs, share of hard cost
soft_pct.assumption: Design, engineering, county and state permits, legal, appraisal and construction interest.

ffe_per_cabin.label: Furnishings per cabin
ffe_per_cabin.assumption: Working allowance for furniture, linens, kitchenware and televisions.

lodge_ffe.label: Lodge furniture and event equipment
lodge_ffe.assumption: Tables, chairs, audio-visual and kitchen equipment for retreat groups.

working_capital.label: Pre-opening and working capital
working_capital.assumption: Marketing, payroll and utilities before bookings reach the Year 1 level.

adr.label: Cabin average daily rate
adr.assumption: No ADR is published for the trade area. Carter Creek's lowest nightly prices for the week of October 12, 2026 ran $120 on Wednesday to $293 on Saturday, plus a $28.25 resort fee [^23,24]; Walden showed $208 a night for October 15 to 16, 2026 and $329 and up in October 2026 [^28,29]. Glamping operators reported a 2025 ADR of $338 for cabins and tiny homes [^42]. We set $265 in Year 1, rising about 3% a year.

occupancy.label: Cabin occupancy
occupancy.assumption: AirDNA expects U.S. short-term rental occupancy of 57.4% in 2026 [^41]. Wine-trail demand is weekend-heavy (a Carter Creek review is titled "Don't stay on weekdays!" [^25]), so the ramp reaches 56% only as retreat groups fill midweek nights.

events.label: Retreats, weddings and group events per year
events.assumption: No event count, festival attendance or hotel tax series exists in the record. One event about every 11 days at stabilization, against Carter Creek's large event plant and Walden's 100-seat banquet room [^22,31].

event_fee.label: Venue and package fee per event
event_fee.assumption: Venue rental, coordination and catering margin per event; no local benchmark. Rises 3% a year.

other_pct.label: Pet fees, rentals and retail, share of cabin revenue
other_pct.assumption: Carter Creek charges a pet fee of $84.75 a stay [^24]; small ancillary income.

payroll.label: Payroll and benefits (Year 1)
payroll.assumption: A working general manager, housekeepers, a maintenance hand and an event coordinator. No local wage data is in the record. Fixed, rising 3% a year.

housekeeping_per_night.label: Laundry and guest supplies per occupied night
housekeeping_per_night.assumption: Linen service, amenities and consumables per occupied cabin night; housekeeping labor sits in payroll. No published benchmark.

commission_pct.label: Booking commissions and marketing, share of cabin revenue
commission_pct.assumption: Online travel agency and platform commissions on part of the bookings, plus paid listings.

event_cost_pct.label: Direct event costs, share of event revenue
event_cost_pct.assumption: Rentals, extra staff and catering cost passed through on events.

util_rm_pct.label: Utilities, repairs and grounds, share of revenue
util_rm_pct.assumption: Electric, propane, well and septic service, hot tub service and grounds.

ga_pct.label: Administration, software and professional fees, share of revenue
ga_pct.assumption: Reservation software, accounting, legal and HOT filing.

reserve_pct.label: Replacement reserve, share of revenue
reserve_pct.assumption: Hot tubs, decks, furnishings and roofs wear quickly on small cabins.

insurance.label: Insurance (Year 1)
insurance.assumption: Site wind, flood and wildfire insurance conditions were NOT FOUND. The Pedernales reached its highest level since 1979 in July 2026 [^39], so the lender must replace this with a bound quote.

tax_county.label: Blanco County tax rate, 2025 (per $1 of value)

sba_guaranty_pct.label: SBA guaranty share, loans of $350,001 to $5 million

rate_7a.label: 7(a) interest rate
rate_7a.assumption: Prime was 7.00% on October 9, 2026 [^48]. SBA caps the spread over Prime by loan size [^46]; 2025 7(a) loans to bed-and-breakfasts averaged 9.49% [^50]. We carry Prime plus 2.5 points. The lender sets the rate at pricing

uses.label: Land, 10 acres with US 290 frontage
uses.basis: acres x asking price per acre [^8]

uses.label: Well, septic, electric, roads and parking

revenue.label: Cabin revenue
revenue.basis: cabins x 365 x occupancy x ADR

opex.label: Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * tract_ask / tract_acres + (cabins * cabin_cost + lodge_cost + site_work) * (1 + contingency_pct)) * (tax_county + tax_isd + tax_esd + tax_gcd) * 1.02 ** y

proposed.note: the sponsor proposes a single 25-year 7(a) loan at the start-up minimum
